plain.li: Pass the salt down this end.
Is there more of this?
Who cooked? Somebody thank them.
I'll do the washing-up tomorrow, I swear.
Save some for whoever's on watch.
[winter] Shut the door, you're letting the snow in.
[lowtech] Bread still warm from the stones.
[child] Can I have the last one?

warm.li: Look at us, all at one table.
Eat up. There's plenty.

cheerful.li: Best meal in weeks.
I'm not moving until morning.

gloomy.li: Enjoy it. It's simple meals again tomorrow.

cold.li: Adequate. Better than adequate, in fact.

plain.li: Tell the one about the boar again.
Who's got the dice?
I haven't laughed like this in a while.
Your turn. Go on.
Who remembers the day we got here?
[child] Just one more game, then bed.

warm.li: We should do this more often.

cheerful.li: Again, again!

gloomy.li: We'll all pay for this in the morning.

cold.li: I suppose this is good for morale.

plain.li: Another log on, somebody.
Look at the sparks go.
Move over, I'm freezing on this side.
My face is hot and my back is cold.
[night] Look at all those stars.
[child] Can I poke it with a stick?

warm.li: Sit closer, there's room.

cheerful.li: Let's keep it going till dawn.

gloomy.li: The smoke always finds me.

cold.li: That's a day's chopping gone up in smoke.

plain.li: Cups up, everyone.
Hear, hear.
Quiet at the back.
To all of us.
Somebody say a few words.

warm.li: To the ones who aren't here to drink with us.

cheerful.li: To us, and to many more of these.

gloomy.li: To getting through the next one.

cold.li: One cup. I'm on watch later.

plain.li: Hush, let them speak.
Go on.
I never knew that.
Can you say that last part again?
[child] Is that true?

warm.li: Thank you for telling us.

cheerful.li: I could listen to this all night.

gloomy.li: That's going to keep me up tonight.

plain.li: You all know this one.
Faster. No, slower.
That's not how the second verse goes.
Clap along, then.
[child] Teach me the words.

warm.li: My mother used to sing this.

blunt.li: I'm not singing, so don't ask.

cheerful.li: Up you get. Dance.

gloomy.li: Why are all the old songs sad?

plain.li: I still set out a cup for them.
They'd have hated all this fuss.
Do you remember how they laughed?
I keep going to call them in for supper.

warm.li: We haven't forgotten you.

cheerful.li: They'd want us to tell the funny stories.

gloomy.li: It doesn't get easier.

plain.li: All hands, please, this won't take long.
Grab whatever's nearest and come on.
[clean] Fetch buckets and brushes, we're scrubbing the floors.
[clean] Every corner this time, not just the middle of the floor.
[haul] Everything lying about goes into the stores.
[repair] Bring a hammer, we're mending what got broken.
[build] Materials to the frames, then we build.
[corpses] Gloves on. Let's see to the dead.
[snow] Grab a shovel, we're digging out the paths.
[sow] Seed baskets and hoes, and out to the fields.
[harvest] It's ripe. Let's bring it in before it spoils.
[cut] Axes, everyone, the marked ones come down today.
[lowtech,harvest] Sickles and baskets, everyone who can walk.

warm.li: If we all pitch in, it's an easy job.
Come on, it goes quicker together.

cheerful.li: Last one finished washes the pots!
Come on, I'll make it fun, I promise.

gloomy.li: It won't do itself, more's the pity.
[corpses] It's a grim job, so we'll share it out.

cold.li: Split it up and we'll be done faster.

plain.li: Pass me that.
Mind your feet.
Where do you want this?
[clean] There's more under here.
[clean] Who tracked mud all the way in here?
[haul] Heavier than it looks.
[haul] Take the other end of this.
[repair] Hold it steady while I nail it.
[build] Hand me the next one.
[corpses] Lift on three, and keep it level.
[snow] My back's going to hate me tomorrow.
[sow] Two seeds to a hole, not three.
[harvest] Look at the size of this one.
[winter] Can't feel my fingers.
[hot] Somebody bring water.
[child] Look, I'm helping!

warm.li: Good work, all of you, we're nearly there.
Take a breather if you need one.

cheerful.li: Look how much we've done already!
[sow|harvest] I'll race you to the end of the row.

gloomy.li: We'll only have to do it all again next week.

plain.li: Spent a few hours on {NAME} with the others. My arms are sore and the place looks better for it.
[clean] Scrubbed floors with the others until my knees were raw. The whole place smells of soap.
[haul] Carried things from one end of the colony to the other all day. Everything has a place now, more or less.
[repair] We mended what was broken. The walls look like walls again.
[build] Worked on the new building with the others. Splinters in both hands, and the walls are going up.
[corpses] We saw to the bodies today. I've washed my hands three times since and they still don't feel clean.
[snow] Dug out the paths with the others. By the time we finished, it had started snowing again.
[sow] Got the seed in the ground with the others, row after row. Dirt under every nail.
[harvest] We brought the harvest in together. My back aches and there's chaff in my hair.

warm.li: Worked side by side with the others today. We talked the whole time, about nothing much.
We got more done together in a few hours than I'd have managed alone in a week.

blunt.li: Sore all over. The work's done, at least.

cheerful.li: We made a game of it and still finished early. Best afternoon in a while.

gloomy.li: Did my share. Blisters on both palms to show for it.

cold.li: The work was done. Some of the others were slower than they ought to have been.

plain.li: We never got round to {NAME}. There was always another job first.
We were all meant to pitch in on {NAME}. It never came to anything.

warm.li: I'd been looking forward to working alongside everyone. I'd even dug out my old gloves.

blunt.li: No work party after all. I did my own share anyway.

cheerful.li: The work party fell through. I'm not going to pretend I minded.

gloomy.li: So much for {NAME}. I waited by the tools for a while, then put them away.

plain.li: If everyone's here, let's go.
Slowly. We'll stay together.
[grave] We'll walk out to the grave together.
[gate] Out to the gate, all of us.
[fields] Let's go and look at the fields.
[water] Come on, down to the water.

warm.li: Walk next to me, if you like.

cheerful.li: Come on, a walk will do us all good!

gloomy.li: [grave] Let's go and see them.
My knees won't thank me for this.

plain.li: Not far now.
Watch your step, it's uneven here.
[grave] Here we are.
[grave] Somebody say something.
[fields] Look how far the rows go.
[gate] The road goes a long way from here.
[water] Listen to the water.
[walkout] You can see the whole colony from out here.
[winter] Watch the ice.
[rain] We'll be soaked through.

warm.li: I'm glad we came out together.
Take my arm if you like.

cheerful.li: I could walk all day!

gloomy.li: These boots were never meant for walking.

plain.li: We all walked out together today and back again, slower than we needed to.
[grave] We walked out to the grave together. Stood there a while. Walked home without saying much.
[fields] We walked out to the fields and stood looking at them for a while. It all looks different from out there.
[gate] We walked to the gate together. The road looked very long from there.
[water] Walked down to the water with the others and back again. My boots are still wet.

warm.li: Walked out with the others today. On the way back someone took my arm and didn't let go.

blunt.li: Walked out. Walked back. My feet hurt.

cheerful.li: A good walk with everyone today. Somebody started singing on the way back.

gloomy.li: We walked out and back. All the way I kept thinking how few of us there are.

cold.li: The walk took longer than it needed to.

plain.li: We never did walk out together for {NAME}. The day got away from us.

warm.li: I wish we'd made that walk together. I'd been thinking about what I'd say on the way.

blunt.li: The walk was called off. Saved my feet.

cheerful.li: No walk after all. There'll be other days for it.

gloomy.li: Maybe {NAME} mattered more to me than to the others. We never went.

plain.li: Bring a blanket, we'll be here a while.
[grave] We'll sit with them a while.
[gate] We'll keep an eye on the gate, all of us.
[beside] I'll sit up with {OTHER_nameDef}.
[fields] Spread out along the fields and keep your eyes open.

warm.li: Come and sit by me, it's warmer with two.

cheerful.li: I'll bring the tea!

gloomy.li: This is going to be a long one.

cold.li: Take your places, and stay awake.

plain.li: Quiet now.
Still here.
[night] Can't see a thing out there.
[grave] Rest easy.
[gate] Anything out there?
[gate] Nothing on the road yet.
[beside] Breathe easy, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[fields] Nothing stirring.
[winter] My breath's freezing.
[rain] Just the rain.

warm.li: I'm here. I'm not going anywhere.
Lean on me if you're cold.

cheerful.li: Not long now, we'll see it through.

gloomy.li: The nights are longer than they used to be.

plain.li: Kept watch for hours. I can barely keep my eyes open, but I'm glad I did.
[grave] Sat by the grave for hours. It's strange how quiet it is out there.
[gate] Watched the gate with the others for hours. Every shadow on the road looked like someone coming.
[beside] Sat up through the night at {OTHER_nameDef}'s side. {OTHER_nameDef} slept, mostly. I didn't.
[fields] Watched the fields through the dark. Nothing came, which is what we hoped.

warm.li: We kept watch together and passed one blanket back and forth the whole time.

cheerful.li: The watch went quicker than I feared. We told stories the whole time, under our breath.

gloomy.li: A long night of waiting. I don't know what I expected.

cold.li: The watch was kept. I'll sleep now.

plain.li: We meant to keep watch, but it never came together.
[beside] I meant to sit up with {OTHER_nameDef}. It didn't happen. I hope {OTHER_pronoun} slept anyway.

warm.li: Somebody should have kept watch. I'm sorry it wasn't me.

cheerful.li: The vigil fell through and I got a full night's sleep. I feel guilty about how good that was.

gloomy.li: The watch was never kept. I lay awake anyway, listening.

cold.li: No watch was kept. A poor decision, and not mine.

plain.li: I'll take this side, you take the other.
Spread out. Shout if you find anything.
[fields] I'll go through the fields.
[water] I'll go along the water.

warm.li: Be careful out there, and come back safe.

cheerful.li: Whoever finds it first gets the best seat at supper!

gloomy.li: We probably won't find anything, but let's look.

cold.li: Search properly, and don't skip anything.

plain.li: Nothing here.
Was that something?
I'll check over there.
[fields] Not in these rows.
[water] Just reeds.
[winter] Too cold to be out here long.
[night] Can't see my own feet.

warm.li: Don't give up yet.

cheerful.li: I've got a good feeling about this spot.

gloomy.li: Waste of time, this.

plain.li: Out searching most of the day. Walked further than I have in weeks.
[fields] Searched up and down the fields. I know every furrow by heart now.
[water] Walked the water's edge for hours. Wet to the knees.

warm.li: We split up to search, and I was glad to see every one of them come back.

cheerful.li: Spent the day searching, and saw a lot of country I hadn't seen before.

gloomy.li: Searched until my feet gave out. I'll be limping tomorrow.

cold.li: The search was done in good order.

plain.li: We meant to go out searching, but we never did.

warm.li: I'd have gone out looking, if anyone had asked me.

cheerful.li: The search never happened. Maybe it'll turn up on its own.

gloomy.li: I keep wondering what we'd have found, if we'd gone looking.

cold.li: The search was never carried out.

plain.li: I'll take it out.
Mind the door, my hands are full.
[other] This is for {OTHER_nameDef}.
[gate] Out to the gate with this.

warm.li: It isn't much, but it's given gladly.

blunt.li: Out of the way, this is heavy.

cheerful.li: Delivery coming through!

gloomy.li: There go our stores.

plain.li: Here. From all of us.
Take it, it's yours.
[other] For you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
[gate] Mind it on the road.

warm.li: With our good wishes.
Safe journey.

cheerful.li: Enjoy it!

gloomy.li: I hope it does some good.

plain.li: Carried the colony's gift out myself today. It was heavier than it looked.
[gate] Carried it out to the gate and handed it over. They didn't stay to talk.
[other] Handed it to {OTHER_nameDef} myself, and got a look of surprise, then thanks.

warm.li: Handed it over myself, and was thanked twice for it.

blunt.li: Carried it out. Handed it over. Back to work.

cheerful.li: I got to be the one to hand it over. I like being the bearer of good things.

gloomy.li: Watched it leave our stores. I hope we don't miss it come winter.

plain.li: It went out of the stores without me in the end. I'd meant to take it myself.

warm.li: I'd have liked to hand it over in person. It went all the same.

blunt.li: Didn't carry it out. It went anyway.

cheerful.li: Someone else saw to it. Saved me the walk.

gloomy.li: It left the stores while I was busy. I never even saw it go.

plain.li: Keep the fire in till I'm back.
Downwind, and quiet.
[lowtech] Fetch my bow.

warm.li: I'll bring something back for the pot.

cheerful.li: Fresh meat tonight, if I'm lucky!

gloomy.li: It'll probably hear me coming.

plain.li: There. By the trees.
Easy now...
Fresh tracks.

warm.li: Quick and clean, that's all I ask.

cheerful.li: Supper's that way!

gloomy.li: Sorry, old thing.

plain.li: Went out on the hunt today. We brought it down, and there's meat for the pot.
[lowtech] Tracked it half the afternoon. A clean kill, and I thanked it, the way I was taught.

warm.li: Brought meat home for everyone. I like being the one who does that.

cheerful.li: Good hunt today! Everyone will eat well.

gloomy.li: We needed the meat. I keep telling myself that.

plain.li: The game got away. We'll make do.

warm.li: The animal got away. Part of me is glad.

cheerful.li: Didn't catch anything, but it was a nice walk.

gloomy.li: Came home empty-handed, as usual.
